note: One layer of what a unit looks like. Layers are stated in the order a client lays them on.

fields.name: assetSize
fields.note: How many bytes the name below occupies.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads this layer's art under. It is not padded, and it carries no terminator.

bits.name: overrideSpells
bits.note: Set where this layer replaces the unit's spells as well as its art.

bits.name: modelOnly
bits.note: Set where it replaces the shape alone.

fields.name: layer
fields.note: The name this layer answers to, so a later message can take it off.
